'''Ch. Empress Sunwinds Messenger Chung-Chung LaFlorin III. Dotty''', or '''Dotty''' for short, was a pet [[Voorpak/Legends|voorpak]] belonging to the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Deprovan]].<ref name="SWG:LDiD" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dotty was first mentioned in a [[W:c:swg:Mission Terminal|mission terminal]] [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].<ref name="SWG:LDiD" />
